story.title: Old Enough Without Death Date
story.content: This story has enough evidence, context, and narrative detail to be reviewed for public beta even though the source person lacks a death date. The birth year is old enough that the living-person risk clears the beta threshold. Reviewers should still prefer a death record when possible, but the missing death date alone should not block public publishing for a person born well over a century ago in a clearly historical setting.
